_comment: Narration lines mirrored from src/book.ts (TITLE_CARD + PAGES[].text/.secondaryText, combined into one clip per page) and the count words for the leaf count (PRD §4.1/§5). Keep this in sync by hand if book.ts changes — it's a thin data copy, not the source of truth.

narration.zh: 妈妈拿来一篮树叶。说声谢谢，贴片叶子。
narration.en: Mama brings a basket of leaves. Say thank you, add a leaf.

narration.zh: 谢谢妈妈给我读书！红叶子，一片！
narration.en: Thank you, Mama, for reading to me! A red leaf. One!

narration.zh: 谢谢爸爸陪我骑车！橙叶子，两片！
narration.en: Thank you, Baba, for biking with me! An orange leaf. Two!

narration.zh: 谢谢婆婆做好吃的！黄叶子，三片！
narration.en: Thank you, Grandma, for yummy food! A yellow leaf. Three!

narration.zh: 谢谢公公陪我种花！绿叶子，四片！
narration.en: Thank you, Grandpa, for gardening with me! A green leaf. Four!

narration.zh: 谢谢小猫做我朋友！棕叶子，五片！
narration.en: Thank you, Mr. Cat, for being my friend! A brown leaf. Five!

narration.zh: 大家说：谢谢小兔！金叶子，六片！
narration.en: Everyone says: Thank you, Little Rabbit! A golden leaf. Six!
